title: Multi-Horizon Echo State Network Prediction of Intraday Stock Returns
abstract: arXiv:2504.19623v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Stock return prediction is a problem that has received much attention in the finance literature. In recent years, sophisticated machine learning procedures have been shown to perform significantly better than conventional prediction techniques. One downside of these approaches is that they are often numerically expensive to implement, for both training and inference, because of their high complexity. We propose a return prediction framework for intraday returns at multiple horizons based on Echo State Network (ESN) models, wherein a large subset of parameters is drawn at random and never trained. The coefficients that do require training can be fitted by explicitly solving a rolling-window, ridge-regularized least squares problem. Our approach enjoys the flexibility of machine learning methods, has an inherently efficient implementation, and shows strong forecasting performance.

translated_title: 基于多时间跨度回声状态网络的日内股票收益率预测
translated_abstract: 股票收益率预测是金融文献中备受关注的问题。近年来，复杂的机器学习方法已被证明显著优于传统预测技术。这些方法的一个缺点是，由于其高复杂性，无论训练还是推理，在数值计算上往往成本高昂。我们提出了一种基于回声状态网络（ESN）模型的日内收益率多时间跨度预测框架，其中大部分参数是随机生成且无需训练的。需要训练的系数可以通过显式求解滚动窗口、岭正则化最小二乘问题来拟合。我们的方法兼具机器学习方法的灵活性、固有的高效实现，并展现出强大的预测性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于回声状态网络（ESN）的多时间跨度日内股票收益率预测框架，大部分参数随机生成无需训练，仅需通过滚动窗口岭正则化最小二乘法拟合少量系数，兼具机器学习的灵活性与计算高效性，并展现出强大的预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Echo State Network-based framework for multi-horizon intraday stock return prediction, where most parameters are randomly drawn and never trained, and the trainable coefficients are fitted via rolling-window ridge-regularized least squares, combining machine learning flexibility with computational efficiency and strong forecasting performance.
